what_this_is: Every transmission substation NESO names at 132 kV and above, with what the operator publishes about it: circuits and their seasonal ratings, transformers, reactive plant, fault level range, and the changes already planned to 2033/34. Coordinates are joined from the OpenStreetMap-derived substation payload where a join exists.
not_a_connection_assessment: Nothing here says a project can or cannot connect at a node. Queue position, committed connections, consent and commercial terms decide that, and no published appendix contains them.

source.note: parameters as published; no power flow is solved here

join.why: ETYS names substations and does not locate them
join.geometry_source: OpenStreetMap contributors, via the GridAtlas release
join.unlocated_are_published: a site nobody has mapped is published without coordinates rather than dropped
